rotation_followup.interpretation: Descriptive selected exchanges; no matched control or causal effect estimate.

protocol.tracking: Detected positions only; 10 Hz input, consecutive six-point half-second chord velocity, scalar acceleration between adjacent windows. Raw spikes >12m/s and all gaps reset filters.
protocol.speed_zones: UEFA-compatible >20 and >25 km/h; sensitivity distances >19.8 and >25.2 km/h are retained.
protocol.acceleration: Local exploratory threshold +/-3m/s2 sustained >=1s, not an adopted UEFA cutoff.
protocol.sprint_repeats: Local definition: >=3 bouts above25km/h lasting>=1s with <=20s recovery, within one period.
protocol.peaks: Rolling1,3,5,10min clock windows, 1Hz anchors, >=80% detected segment exposure; distances are not scaled to fill missing time.
protocol.rotation: Five consecutive 1Hz possession samples, persistent3m pair-order change, both move>=3m, pair<=25m, cross-axis gap<=15m,20s cooldown.
protocol.transition: Provider quick_break/transition phases, first<=10s, minimum3s, variable horizon retained. Counterpress labels and phase taxonomy are vendor-derived.
protocol.shape: At least8 detected outfield players; rest-defense count additionally needs a detected ball. Both axes orient toward each team attacking goal.
protocol.fitness_limit: Camera-selected external match load is not conditioning capacity, fatigue diagnosis, injury risk or complete GPS workload. No heart rate, RPE, training load or fitness-test measurements are available.
protocol.sample_limit: 20 selected A-League2024/25 fixtures; no unseen league or season validation.

professional_sources.title: Croatia: Evolving third-player combinations
professional_sources.application: Interpret movement relative to pressure, space and team-mate actions. A pair-order exchange is only a candidate for video review.

professional_sources.title: Attacking and defensive transitions, Adrian Boothroyd
professional_sources.application: Measure support after regaining possession and defensive reorganisation after loss; link geometry with counter-press events.

professional_sources.title: EURO 2024 physical analysis report
professional_sources.application: Speed zones >20 and >25 km/h; 1, 3, 5 and 10 minute rolling demands; positional and possession context. This optical sample uses different filtering and cannot reproduce UEFA tournament benchmarks.

professional_sources.title: Is it worth the effort? Understanding and contextualizing physical metrics in soccer
professional_sources.application: Associate running with technical-tactical context. We do not reproduce the paper possession-value model or interpret vendor EPV as ground truth.

limits: Only one complete multi-league player-event season is covered.
Roster position metadata has no per-match historical timestamp; evaluations are retrospective and not proven prospective.
Conditional beta/gamma intervals assume exchangeable attempts/counts and do not capture all opponent or measurement error.
Goalkeeper success rates lack shot-difficulty adjustment.
Historical profiles and neighbour suggestions are not current transfer recommendations.
Chance prefixes span a selective public archive, not representative complete leagues.
Tactical associations, rotation follow-ups and observed workloads have no causal identification.
Raw games, private FM conversions and individual model binaries are excluded from this public export.

results.note: Exploratory comparison only; no production model is saved and release gates remain required.

protocol.features: Pre-match rolling form/Elo; earlier held-out results update team state, never the estimator
protocol.fit_cutoff: Before earliest held-out fixture across participating leagues
protocol.hyperparameter_selection: Fixed exploratory presets, no holdout selection
protocol.note: Repeated retrospective comparisons, not independent future validation or production release.
protocol.preset_origin: SGD alpha=0.1 reuses prior PL exploration; all comparisons are retrospective
protocol.provider_pooling: Never combine providers; each provider is evaluated separately

sources.title: FIFA talent identification, Module3
sources.application: Separate current performance from future potential; retain structured observations, relative age and missing maturation information.

sources.title: Tom Bergkamp, How scouts assess players
sources.application: Use explicit evidence and repeated observations; measured physical output alone is not a talent label.

cohort_aggregation.note: Generator-fed cohort aggregation; weights are located ball actions, not minutes or measured standing time. No performance claim.

definitions.metadata_timestamp: Roster role and reported preferred foot lack dated historical snapshots; early-cutoff cards remain retrospective observations.
definitions.ages: Exact calendar ages16-21 at the observation cutoff, not competition U21 eligibility.
definitions.opportunity: At least90 observed minutes enter the longlist; <450min or <5matches retain limited-observation status.
definitions.priority: Manual review flag: sufficient exposure and >=75th role/league dimension percentile. Current performance, not future talent.
definitions.age_peers: Age bands16-18 and19-21 within league and broad role; percentiles require>=5peers with>=450min.
definitions.habits: Wyscout normalized0-100 ball-action locations, pass direction>=5x units, crosses and tagged shot foot. Sparse/unknown fields remain unknown.
definitions.persistent: Dominant passing direction recurs in>=65% of at least8matches with>=5located foot passes; ties count as co-dominant.
definitions.potential: Real future ceiling and maturation remain unknown; a single season cannot validate long-term growth.
definitions.birth_quarter: Descriptive birth-month groups only; no population denominator or competition cutoff to estimate relative-age bias.
definitions.game: Previously verified identity links and snapshots strictly before cutoff; game potential is context only.
definitions.opponents: Competition-season and home/away aligned, comparing the opponent with the same team facing other opponents. Observational, not an instruction to change tactics.
